newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Upper, N.J.

text.p: SUMMARY OF NOTICE OF SCHOOL BOND SALE
The Board of Education of The Township of Upper

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Board Secretary of The Board of Education of the Township of Upper in the County of Cape May, New Jersey at the offices of the Board of Education, 525 Perry Road, Petersburg, New Jersey 08270 on until 12:00 noon, for the purchase of the above Bonds of the Board of Education due (without option of prior redemption) on March 1 as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one bond for the aggregate principal amount maturing in each year. The Board of Education will furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of Lowenstein, Sandler, Kohl, Fisher & Boylan, P.A.
The Bonds will bear interest at a rate of interest in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder payable on September 1, 1997 and

semiannually thereafter on first days of March and September in each year until maturity. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest in accordance with the Notice of Sale.
The Bonds of this issue are not subject to redemption prior to their stated maturities.
The Bonds are subject to the requirements of SEC Rule 15c2-12 with respect to secondary market disclosure.
The Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms are available by contacting the Board Secretary at the Board of Education, 525 Perry Road, Petersburg, New Jersey 08270, (609) 628-3513.
